question: Lalgudi Gopala Iyer Jayaraman used to play which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Violin__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Point__**

__
 
• **Lalgudi Gopala Iyer Jayaraman **was an Indian Carnatic violinist, vocalist and composer.
 
• He is commonly grouped with** M.S. Gopalakrishnan and T.N. Krishnan **as part of the violin-trinity of Carnatic Music.
 
• **The violin **is sometimes known as a fiddle.
 
• **Violin** is a wooden chordophone in the violin family.
 
• Most** violins** have a hollow wooden body.
 
• It is the smallest and thus** highest-pitched instrument** in the family in regular use. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Harmonium** is a modified version of the reed organ, with keys like the piano and bellows to pump air into the instrument.
 
• The standard concert** flute has a range of about 3 octaves.**
 
• **​Mridangam **is the main percussion instrument of the South Indian or Carnatic form of music.​
